Bookkeeping from zero

Software and bank feeds

Questions

Good to know

Do I need qualifications or experience?

No. The guide starts from zero and is written in plain English. You do not need a degree or any maths skills to learn the bookkeeping side and start helping small businesses with it.

How do I get the guides?

Immediately after payment you are taken to a download page with both PDFs. Stripe also emails you a receipt.

Is this only for the UK?

It is written for the UK: HMRC, VAT, Self Assessment, Making Tax Digital and prices in pounds. The bookkeeping fundamentals apply anywhere.

Which accounting software does it use?

The method works in any cloud accounting software. The guide compares the three most used by UK small businesses and shows you how to set one up.

What is in the bonus guide?

Find Your First Clients: how to choose a niche, build an Instagram and Facebook presence, run a small local Facebook ad, message prospects, run a discovery call, send a proposal and use a ready-made engagement letter.

What devices can I read it on?

Any phone, tablet or computer that opens PDF files. The pages are designed to be easy to read on a screen or to print.
